definitions.name: disconnect cancels an unlimited Ollama decision through the real router before any upstream call
completed streamed usage is correlated with its request before completion and never added to debug logs

assertion_order_scope: Raw successful assertion order retained separately. Per-site and per-callback counts are exact; no scheduling or chunk partition equivalence is inferred.
network_scope: Actual synthetic gateway/provider loopback HTTP; original #29 uses the real frozen Router and its original injected fetchImpl, while #30–#32 use supplied route callbacks. No real evaluator calls.
capture_semantics: Complete selected callbacks and five helper statements restored unchanged except successful assertion-result wrappers. Recording delegates actual HTTP and original return objects; no clone/drain, substituted verdict, timing threshold or source clock changes. Per-peer complete bodies preserve actual parser-delivered bytes; raw push chunks and chronological reads remain in raw observations. Provider request bodies remain unread by the original callbacks. Original unlimited evaluator body remains pending until real downstream cancellation, with actual signal-abort and reader.cancel observations delegated unchanged. Every usage/pricing source assertion and every #32 statuses reset remains intact. The status callback Promise catch method is observed only when the original safe emitter installs and executes its own handler; the recorder never adds a detached rejection handler. Asynchronous assertions are counted only after their original Promise resolves successfully.
typed_observations: Headers inputs are enumerated into their complete normalized field map.
Route signal observation records actual AbortSignal type and aborted state; no serialized object identity is claimed. countTokens is recorded as a function capability only.
Individual response chunks remain base64, including intentionally split UTF-8. Only complete request bodies use UTF-8 after exact roundtrip validation.
